LITTLETON, Mass., Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Precision Optics Corporation, Inc. (NASDAQ: POCI), a leading designer and manufacturer of advanced optical instruments for the medical and defense/aerospace industries, will participate in a webcast presentation and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, taking place virtually on September 29-30, 2026.


**Company Webcast**


The webcast presentation will take place at 3:15 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The webcast can be accessed by visiting the conference website at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bu7dyx_T4S6JorpER8Cfn5g2IkXB6FhUc2uzik6XFEE0vxopIZrAcRl86U_TEcZXD-z_t1UmmXNwt2j0ezcoibFKeHfjzCkJsxJbnMCxwVXSArEJ_GwSO0PLm0Om07J6wOtIc2qSsKa-mFa6DZrHZQ==) or directly at[https://app.webinar.net/yD2Bjwd63Jb](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bu7dyx_T4S6JorpER8Cfn0U0Gk0GWf1Pu4lr2pR2oQ9ukF3rv4Yh7r-cKKLR0t0GkOp8iOinlMowwo7YKl6lDOCSkw2Nnf7THC_tHxQZZ39jyyMrDiqnWnm7b7O-lAstUGfxOahhNTiqKKMhWS43Dw==) . The webcast will also be available for replay following the event.


**1×1 Meetings**


Management will be participating in virtual one-on-one meetings throughout the event. To arrange a meeting with management, please contact Lytham Partners at[1×1@lythampartners.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D7ivjS0wR2VTgwf9GuQmM6auKnlSNEnjDDvifMO94MUG5cvGzaUSqLpMgyfPjuzGnX-kxSHePDyqFF-AlwSe32VYaHozEctD3QJDnt11FIQ=) or register for the event at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026invreg/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bu7dyx_T4S6JorpER8Cfn5g2IkXB6FhUc2uzik6XFEGVbJAvZYrO4F-thQVodhhXeeBjYgSkpHfhVnLJIDMyH4xEeMJ8Jc0JrpDWSl2Ru7DRkjFmcJh6P-jVTHjrsHHyIIL4F1hZguqWcUTSj4WJtQ==) .


**About Precision Optics Corporation**


Founded in 1982, Precision Optics is a vertically integrated optics company focused on leveraging its proprietary micro-optics, multi-channel and ultra-high precision imaging and digital imaging technologies across the medical device, defense/aerospace and satellite communications markets. Through its Systems Manufacturing, Engineering, Ross Optical and Micro-Optics Lab operations, the Company provides services from new product concept and design through volume production. Its in-house optical, mechanical, electrical and systems engineering, prototyping, regulatory support, fabrication, assembly and manufacturing capabilities enable it to develop next-generation solutions for demanding customer requirements. In medical devices, Precision Optics supports minimally invasive and robotic surgery with micro-endoscopes, single-use and reusable endoscopes, digital imaging and related optical assemblies. In defense/aerospace and satellite communications, the Company applies its micro-optics and opto-mechanical expertise to applications requiring high quality and optimized size, weight and power. Ross Optical complements these capabilities through global sourcing, inspection and production of custom and catalog optics. For more information, please visit www.poci.com.
